summary: Mixed-health system with modern Python architecture but significant legacy VB6 technical debt and security vulnerabilities

hotspots.reason: Hardcoded database paths, basic password masking, no modern authentication mechanisms
Legacy ADO connections with potential SQL injection vulnerabilities and hardcoded connection strings

provenance.evidence: Microsoft ActiveX Data Objects 2.0 Library reference

hotspots.reason: High coupling between 11 different agent types with unclear error propagation
Minimal error handling in form events, direct form navigation without validation

provenance.evidence: Direct Form.Show calls without error handling

risks.title: Legacy Database Security Exposure
risks.description: VB6 application uses legacy ADO connections with hardcoded paths and minimal security controls, exposing customer financial data

risks.title: State Store Dependency Risk
risks.description: Recent Firestore/GCS fixes indicate instability in core state management, potentially affecting agent coordination

risks.title: Legacy Code Maintenance Burden
risks.description: VB6 codebase with minimal documentation and basic error handling creates high maintenance overhead

risks.title: Agent Orchestration Failure Points
risks.description: Complex multi-agent system with unclear failure modes and error propagation patterns
